readings.title: The Divisions of the Gatekeepers
readings.subtitle: The Sons of Qorḥites and Oḇěḏ-Eḏom
readings.text:
[1 Chronicles 26:1] For the divisions of the gatekeepers: Of the Qorḥites, Meshelemyahu son of Qorě, of the sons of Asaph.
[2] And the sons of Meshelemyahu: Zeḵaryahu the first-born, Yeḏiya’ěl the second, Zeḇaḏyahu the third, Yathni’ěl the fourth,
[3] Ěylam the fifth, Yehoḥanan the sixth, Elyo‛ěynai the seventh.
[4] And the sons of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom: Shemayah the first-born, Yehozaḇaḏ the second, Yo’aḥ the third, Saḵar the fourth, Nethan’ěl the fifth,
[5] Ammi’ěl the sixth, Yissasḵar the seventh, Pe‛ullethai the eighth, for <dn>Elohim</dn> blessed him.
[6] Also to Shemayah his son were sons born who ruled their fathers’ houses, because they were able mighty men.
[7] The sons of Shemayah: Othni, and Repha’ěl, and Oḇěḏ, Elzaḇaḏ, whose brothers Elihu and Semaḵyahu were able men.
[8] All these were of the sons of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom, they and their sons and their brothers, able men with strength for the work: sixty-two of Oḇěḏ-Eḏom.
[9] And Meshelemyahu had sons and brothers, eighteen able men.

readings.title: The Gatekeeper Assignments
readings.subtitle: The Sons of Merari and the Casting of Lots
readings.text:
[10] Also Ḥosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the head (although he was not the first-born, his father made him the head),
[11] Ḥilqiyahu the second, Teḇalyahu the third, Zeḵaryahu the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Ḥosah were thirteen.
[12] These divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, had duties like their brothers, to serve in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[13] And they cast lots for each gate, the small as well as the great, according to their father’s house.
[14] And the lot to the east fell to Shelemyahu. Then they cast lots for his son Zeḵaryahu, a wise counsellor, and his lot came out to the north;
[15] to Oḇěḏ-Eḏom to the south, and to his sons <dn>את</dn> the storehouse;
[16] to Shuppim and Ḥosah to the west, with the Shalleḵeth Gate on the ascending highway; guard corresponding with guard.
[17] On the east were six Lěvites, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and for the storehouse two by two.
[18] As for the Parbar on the west, there were four on the highway and two at the Parbar.
[19] These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Qoraḥ and among the sons of Merari.

readings.title: The Treasurers and Custodians
readings.subtitle: Guardians of the Sacred and Dedicated Gifts
readings.text:
[20] And of the Lěvites, Aḥiyah was over the treasuries of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn> and over the treasuries of the set-apart {gifts.
[21] The sons of La‛dan, the sons of the Gěrshonites of La‛dan, heads of their fathers’ houses, of La‛dan the Gěrshonite: Yeḥi’ěli.
[22] The sons of Yeḥi’ěli, Zětham and Yo’ěl his brother, were over the treasuries of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[23] Of the Amramites, the Yitsharites, the Ḥeḇronites, and the Uzzi’ělites,
[24] even Sheḇu’ěl son of Gěreshom, son of Mosheh, was overseer of the treasuries.
[25] And his brothers by Eli‛ezer were Reḥaḇyahu his son, and Yeshayahu his son, and Yoram his son, and Ziḵri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
[26] This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the set-apart gifts which Sovereign Daviḏ and the heads of fathers’ houses, the commanders over thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army, had set apart.
[27] Some of the booty won in battles they set apart to maintain the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[28] And all that Shemu’ěl the seer, and Sha’ul son of Qish, and Aḇněr son of Něr, and Yo’aḇ son of Tseruyah had set apart, all who were setting apart, were under the hand of Shelomith and his brothers.

readings.title: Officials and Judges
readings.subtitle: Overseers Beyond the Jordan
readings.text:
[29] Of the Yitsharites, Kenanyahu and his sons were for the outward duties as officials and judges over Yisra’ěl.
[30] Of the Ḥeḇronites, Ḥashaḇyahu and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred able men, had the oversight of Yisra’ěl beyond the Yarděn westward, for all the work of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and in the service of the sovereign.
[31] Of the Ḥeḇronites, Yeriyah was head of the Ḥeḇronites according to his genealogy of the fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of Daviḏ they were sought, and there were found among them able men at Ya‛zěr of Gil‛aḏ.
[32] And his brothers were two thousand seven hundred able men, heads of fathers’ houses, whom Sovereign Daviḏ made officials over the Re’uḇěnites, and the Gaḏites, and the half-tribe of Menashsheh, in all matters of <dn>Elohim</dn> and matters of the sovereign.

readings.title: David's Address to the Assembly
readings.subtitle: The Divine Mandate for Solomon's Reign
readings.text:
[1 Chronicles 28:1] And Daviḏ assembled at Yerushalayim <dn>את</dn> all the rulers of Yisra’ěl: <dn>את</dn> the rulers of the tribes and <dn>את</dn> the commanders of the divisions who served the sovereign, <dn>את</dn> the commanders over thousands and commanders over hundreds, and <dn>את</dn> the heads over all the property and possessions of the sovereign and of his sons, with the officials, the mighty men, and all the mighty brave men.
[2] Then Sovereign Daviḏ rose to his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people: <dn>I</dn> had it in <dn>my</dn> heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and for the footstool of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, and had made preparations to build it.
[3] “But <dn>Elohim</dn> said to me, <dq>‘You do not build a house for <dn>My</dn> Name, because you have been a man of battle and have shed blood.’</dq>
[4] “Yet <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl chose me above all the house of my father to be sovereign over Yisra’ěl forever, for <dn>He</dn> has chosen Yehuḏah to be the ruler. And of the house of Yehuḏah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father, <dn>He</dn> was pleased with me to make me reign over all Yisra’ěl.
[5] “And of all my sons – for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given me many sons – <dn>He</dn> has chosen my son Shelomoh to sit on the throne of the reign of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> over Yisra’ěl,
[6] and said to me, <dq>‘Shelomoh your son is the one to build <dn>My</dn> house and <dn>My</dn> courtyards, for <dn>I</dn> have chosen him to be <dn>My</dn> son, and <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> am a Father to him.</dq>
[7] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall establish his reign forever, if he is strong to do <dn>My</dn> commands and <dn>My</dn> right-rulings, as it is this day.’</dq>
[8] “And now, before the eyes of all Yisra’ěl, the assembly of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and in the hearing of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, guard and seek <dn>את</dn> all the commands of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, so that you possess this good land, and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever.

readings.title: A Father's Charge to His Son
readings.subtitle: Serve YeHoVaH with a Perfect Heart
readings.text:
[9] “As for you, my son Shelomoh, know <dn>את</dn> the <dn>Elohim</dn> of your father, and serve <dn>Him</dn> with a perfect heart and with a pleasing life, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> searches all hearts and understands all the intent of the thoughts. If you do seek <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> is found by you; but if you forsake <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> rejects you forever.
[10] “See, now, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has chosen you to build a house for the set-apart place. Be strong, and do it.”

readings.title: The Plans for the Temple
readings.subtitle: Given by the Spirit and the Hand of YeHoVaH

readings.title: Be Strong and Courageous
readings.subtitle: Final Encouragement and Assurance of Help
readings.text:
[20] And Daviḏ said to his son Shelomoh, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not fear nor be afraid, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, is with you. <dn>He</dn> shall not leave you nor forsake you, until you have completed <dn>את</dn> all the work for the service of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[21] “And see, the divisions of the priests and the Lěvites for all the service of the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, and every volunteer of any skill is with you in all work, for every kind of service. And the rulers and all the people are entirely at your command.”
